layman_headline: Current positions are working — no new high-conviction setups today.
layman_explanation: Both of our existing trades (Solana and Uniswap) are in the green, up 2.2% and 4.7% respectively. The broader market is flat with Bitcoin holding around $78,000 and the Fear & Greed index cooling from 69 to 62. The swing trade candidates on the watchlist are either overbought (PUMP), wildly overextended (PONS up 431% in a week), or lack enough technical data to justify a new entry. With Bitcoin dominance near 60%, altcoins face headwinds, making it wise to be patient.
layman_action: Hold your current SOL and UNI positions. Both are trending toward their profit targets. No new trades warranted — wait for a cleaner setup with better risk/reward.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is unusually weak this cycle. PUMP has an RSI of 75 (overbought) while simultaneously down 13% on the week — a divergence suggesting distribution, not accumulation. PONS is up 431% in 7 days with no RSI/MACD data — chasing that is pure speculation. MON lacks technical indicators and is down 45% from ATH with no clear catalyst. Gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) are pulling back 4% and don't fit swing trade targets. Our existing SOL position benefits from the ETH golden cross narrative and strong weekly momentum (+9.1%), while UNI at +4.7% is approaching its $5.65 target after a 19.7% weekly run. BTC dominance at 59.7% remains a headwind for alts, and the Fear & Greed trend is worsening (69→62), suggesting caution on new entries.
